description: Kinkerstraat 1902-1903 rows (315-359, 334-374): dark red-brown brick, 3 axes, segmental-arched windows under brick relieving arches, the centre axis a stack of French windows with iron balconettes, simple brick cornice; crowns: a square dormer, a curved gable with an arched attic light, a stepped gable; shop ground
